host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: ls crates/athena-cli/tests | ls -1 crates/athena-cli/tests/common; ls crates/athena-core/tests
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --test context_compression 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-cli --lib status_prints_the_context_line 2>&1
cargo test -p xtask --test policy --test ci_shards --test spec --quiet 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: ls crates/athena-core/tests | head -50; sed -n 40,200p crates/athena-core/src/store.rs; sed -n 500,530p crates/athena-core/src/store.rs; sed -n 195,225p crates/athena-data/src/records.rs; sed -n 700,745p crates/athena-data/src/records.rs
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --test context_compression 2>&1 | tail -50
git diff --stat && ls crates/athena-cli/src | ls -1 | head -0; ls crates/athena-cli/src
